title: LunarCrush cheapest plan corrected
summary: Cheapest paid plan is Light at $90/mo billed monthly ($72/mo yearly), with API access at 10 requests/min and 2,000/day. The $240 we showed was Medium billed yearly.

title: DefiLlama Pro billing clarified
summary: Pro is $49/mo billed monthly; the $40.83/mo figure is the $490/yr yearly price.

title: Dune Analyst monthly price
summary: Analyst is $75/mo billed monthly or $65/mo billed yearly (4,000 credits). The free plan cannot use the API.

title: Birdeye free API limits
summary: Free Standard tier: 30,000 compute units/month at 1 request/sec, with no overage.

title: GeckoTerminal free API confirmed
summary: The public API works without a key at 10 calls/min.

title: Bubblemaps API pricing added
summary: API Starter is $170/mo ($136/mo billed yearly) for 100,000 credits.

title: New Token safety category
summary: Added RugCheck, GoPlus, Jupiter Tokens API, Solsniffer and Token Sniffer, plus Solscan, GMGN, Axiom and Photon. Arkham's free alternative is now Bubblemaps.
